title: Quenched Algerian Turkey Neck Tagine
description: A delicious and comforting Algerian tagine recipe featuring tender turkey neck in a rich and flavorful sauce.
instructions: Heat olive oil in a large Dutch oven over medium-high heat.
Add the turkey neck and cook until browned on all sides, about 5 minutes.
Remove the turkey neck from the pot and set it aside.
Add more oil if necessary, then sauté the onion until softened, about 5 minutes.
Add the chicken broth, diced tomatoes, cumin, paprika, salt, and black pepper to the pot. Stir to combine.
Return the turkey neck to the pot and bring the mixture to a boil.
Reduce the heat to low, cover the pot, and simmer for 2 hours, or until the turkey is tender.
During the last 30 minutes of cooking, add the saffron threads to the pot.
Taste and adjust the seasoning as needed.
Stir in some chopped fresh parsley and serve the tagine hot, garnished with additional parsley if desired.
Be careful when serving, as the tagine will be very hot and the turkey neck may be falling off the bone.
